## Live replacement

**Live file swap: none.** new build = new play disc and relaunch; the native runner has no save-state interface, so a swap cannot keep the moment

**Pick whip: none.** xbox is not a pick_tool live platform and DOA3 has no entity backend or camera profile; pick_replace can only build

**Live controls:** Guest RAM = Read/WriteProcessMemory on the runner's unique 64 MiB allocation, anchored by XBE header + code hashes (doa3_memory). write_memory: any non-code address, <=4 KiB, read back. doa3_bot plays Survival via the port-4 pad and picks a cast build's swapped fighters by cursor.

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- no costume index in the RAM map (only character), so there is no live costume select
- general GuestMemory.write has no live receipt; only the pad block is exercised; xbox-launch.md still says no writes
- no save state, so a build swap loses the moment; no live model inject for Xbox
- fighter positions unmapped; three family -> character indexes unpinned; Tengu not covered
